gen-gf-baumans-gf-telex: Telex curves loosely and freely, nothing clamped down. Baumans above it is the opposite, a commanding display face drawn with joins as slim as a pipe cleaner, so a small heading would lose its force while a larger Telex body would turn bulky.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tenor-sans: Round, wide-open, unmistakably distinctive: that is Baumans, every stroke held to one thickness. And Tenor Sans, a contemporary sans, adds a faint nib-pressure swell across its round letters, which is the quality that keeps the pairing from feeling mechanical.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tirra: Tirra reads modern and neutral, its round forms bowing like open parentheses. Baumans does the commanding part, with strokes like thread stitched along a path, while Tirra simply carries the sentences without asking for attention.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tomorrow: Baumans draws true monoline, every stroke the same weight, and that gives it a commanding, distinctive look. Tomorrow takes over where the headline stops, its bowls opening like a cupped palm of clay and staying clean for the actual sentences.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-varela: Baumans is a commanding display face with a wide, gaping c and every stroke drawn at one thickness. But Varela, a modern sans with a wide-mouthed look, is approachable enough that you could raise its size a notch without it competing.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-varela-round: Strokes of identical thickness give Baumans its distinctive, commanding look. Varela Round sits next to it feeling modern and clean, its wide-mouthed rounds softening the heading's firmness without arguing with it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-vazirmatn: Baumans stays commanding and distinctive with no calligraphic thinning anywhere in its outlines. But Vazirmatn, an approachable sans-serif with a wide-open s, tends to read best if you give it a little extra size.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office has a contemporary, open-ended look on every curved letter. Baumans does its best work as the commanding heading, a ring of an o with a constant wall, while Ysabeau Office does its best work carrying the text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Baumans draws a round bowl whose outline never swells or thins. ZCOOL XiaoWei, meanwhile, brings a mild stress in the o and e, so a longer read feels modern and clean, with a gentle shift in weight from stem to serif.
gen-gf-baumans-ibm-plex-sans: Bold, round and distinctive, Baumans keeps its t crossbar and stem at matching weight. IBM Plex Sans takes the lower ground with a technical but approachable voice, its wide channel into every bowl letting the heading lead.
